payload.name: Fix FAQ accordion behavior
payload.description:
Investigate and fix the FAQ accordion behavior across the entire RobinOS application.

Issue:
Currently FAQ accordions allow multiple items to remain open at the same time. When a user opens a new FAQ item, previously opened items stay expanded.

Expected Behavior:
- Only ONE FAQ item should be open at any given time.
- Opening a new FAQ item should automatically close the previously opened item.
- Clicking an already open item should collapse it.
- This behavior should be applied consistently to every FAQ/accordion section used for question-answer content across the site.

Requirements:
1. Find all FAQ accordion implementations in the codebase.
2. Identify whether they use Radix Accordion, shadcn/ui Accordion, or a custom accordion implementation.
3. Convert all FAQ accordions to single-open behavior.
4. Preserve all existing styling, animations, spacing, icons, colors, content, and responsiveness.
5. Do not modify any copy/text.
6. Do not change any unrelated UI or business logic.
7. Do not modify authentication, subscriptions, affiliate tracking, commissions, payouts, analytics, database schema, routes, or backend functionality.
8. Only change the accordion behavior required for this fix.

Deliverables:
- List all files modified.
- Explain root cause.
- Confirm previous FAQ item now closes automatically when another item is opened.
- Confirm no unrelated files or systems were changed.
- Provide git commit hash after completion.

goal.answer: Convert all FAQ accordion sections in RobinOS to single-open behavior, where only one item can be expanded at a time and clicking an already-open item collapses it. Preserve all existing styling, animations, spacing, icons, colors, content, and responsiveness.

payload.summary: Phase 1 completed successfully. The FAQ accordion in LaunchPartnersPage.tsx was converted from independent per-item state to parent-controlled single-open behavior. Each FaqItem now receives `isOpen` and `onToggle` props. Parent tracks `openIndex: number | null`. Only one FAQ item can be expanded at a time. Clicking an open item collapses it. All styling, animations, content, and responsiveness preserved. EntryPage.tsx verified to already use shadcn/ui single-open Accordion. Build passes, no new lint issues in changed file. Git commit hash: 05d438b.

payload.finalSummary: FAQ accordion single-open behavior has been fixed across RobinOS. LaunchPartnersPage.tsx was the only file with broken multi-open behavior — each FaqItem used independent useState(false). The fix lifted state to the parent component with `openIndex: number | null`, converting FaqItem to controlled props (`isOpen`, `onToggle`). EntryPage.tsx was verified to already use correct shadcn/ui `<Accordion type="single" collapsible>`. No other FAQ accordion implementations exist. Build passes, no new lint issues. Git commit: 05d438b. All styling, animations, copy, and responsiveness preserved exactly.
